notes.title: 🔥 Official Release: Whispers of Lust 🔥
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613931/ef1e15a47d984a70b99606faa39fe48de80c8ff5.png
Dear players and fans of steamy adventures,

We are proud to present the long-awaited hentai visual novel Whispers of Lust—a tale where magic, intrigue, and burning desires intertwine!

🔮 Step into the world of a mysterious academy, where every student hides dark secrets, and lessons go far beyond ordinary sorcery…

💋 Game Features:
✔ An immersive, choice-driven story.
✔ Unique heroines with "deep" backstories.
✔ Beautiful stylized artwork.
✔ Explicit animated 18+ scenes that bring your wildest fantasies to life.
✔ A dark, atmospheric soundtrack.

🎁 As a special launch bonus, early players will receive an exclusive reward!
